# HANDOFF: local-9b @ 128k

Goal: run local-9b at 128k (131072) without VRAM spill.

Root cause: at 128k the WDDM ceiling (7881 MiB) is hit; the mmproj offload spilled 1494 MiB to Shared Usage, contaminating decode (baseline 37.8 t/s invalid).

Fix: `--no-mmproj-offload` + `-ub 512` -> spill gone, 7697 MiB, 38.0 t/s (median of 3).

Quant: Q6_K (7.03 GiB) no fit -> discarded. Q4_K_M (7305 MiB, 40.4 t/s) -> fallback only.

Applied to scripts/start_server.ps1:165 (local9 block) + profiles/local/local-9b.json.

Left to do: (1) evals README still cites check_vision.ps1, now gone; (2) review the scratchpad temp file names.

Assumption: those files (scripts/, profiles/, evals README) are not in this workspace; only session/transcript.md + AGENTS.md are. Verify on the real repo first.

Found: the spill = mmproj offload; the fix removes it. From signal lines 30, 44, 124, 132, 185, 222; every other line is repeated filler.
